content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHM Lakshadweep Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM Lakshadweep to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Health Mission Lakshadweep (NHM Lakshadweep) to fill various medical and healthcare vacancies on a contract basis across the Lakshadweep region.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available for various posts including Nursing Officer, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Assistant, and Pulmonologist under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NHM Lakshadweep recruitment is 03-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The applications for NHM Lakshadweep recruitment must be submitted through the online mode via the official portal or designated application channels specified by the department.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants across all posts in this notification is 40 years. Candidates must check specific educational criteria before applying.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee for all eligible categories is listed as Nil.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised positions involves a Virtual Interview conducted by the competent authority of NHM Lakshadweep.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for the Nursing Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed +2 in Science Group and successfully completed a Degree or Diploma Course in General Nursing and Midwifery or Nursing approved by the Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Pulmonologist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Pulmonologist post will receive a salary of 200000.00 per month, reflecting the specialized medical qualifications required for the role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the direct link to apply and view the notification?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links for the official notification PDF, online application, and official website in the Important Links section of this recruitment article.
